apps.localizedDescription:
9 FAN-FAVORITE GAMES IN 1 APP 
Get ready to play your way with a collection of Toca Boca Jr’s most-loved games! Perfect for ages 4-10, you’re free to play, create, and explore at your own pace. Build a world to explore in Blocks, take care of animals in Pet Doctor, or find your style in Hair Salon. There’s so much to do in Toca Boca Jr. Classics! 
KITCHEN 2: Become a star chef and get creative in the kitchen!
PET DOCTOR: Help your animal friends feel their best. 
BUILDERS: Create anything you can imagine with builder buddies! 
MINI: Explore self-expression and design your own characters. 
HAIR SALON: Cut, color, style, and go wild with hair!
